::: {#def-feature}

#### Feature (input variable, predictor, covariate, attribute, independent variable)

A **feature** is one measured property of an input, written as a number
[@wikipedia_feature_machine_learning].

Other names:
a feature is also called an **input variable**, a **predictor**, a **covariate**,
an **attribute** or an **independent variable**.
The word *predictor* names a feature, not a model.

:::
